title: 第六章 霸气柠柠
slug: 什么网恋的清冷校花竟是双胞胎
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

张晚柠立马回了消息，因为她跟自己姐姐说了今天不回去，但是没跟妈说，现在姐姐这么问指定是自己妈问了。

【我在学校呢，老妈那边你帮我应付一下呗，你就说我去参加活动了。】

姐姐大人：【哎，行吧，她信不信，我就不知道了，我尽量帮你瞒着吧。】

发完消息后，张晚柠看了一眼走在自己身前的舟舟，突然间心里对姐姐有一些愧疚，毕竟舟舟最开始是跟自己打游戏认识的，可真要说网恋还是自己姐姐主动的。

当时俩人就一台手机，微信号用的也是自己母亲注册的，自然也就说好了二四六自己玩，一三五姐姐玩，周末各玩半天，当时为此还跟姐姐吵了一架。

“你跟他网恋了我怎么和他玩游戏，而且明明是我先认识的，你怎么能抢走我的朋友！”

“我再也不理你了！”

姐姐实在也没办法，走到她身边安抚着她。

“柠柠，那我们轮着来，好嘛？”

那时候张晚柠也不知道为什么非得和自己姐姐抢，或许是自己姐姐从小就是什么都比自己好一点，成绩比自己好，考了南城大学，这样母亲也就骂的姐姐比较少，但母亲骂她的时候总要带上姐姐。

“你就不能学学你姐姐嘛，跟她一样让我省心吗？”

“你一个小女生，咋咋呼呼的算什么？女孩子就要像你姐姐那样，温婉淑良，以后才能嫁个好老公！”

张晚柠挺不忿的，毕竟为什么自己就要像姐姐一样呢，虽然她知道这种对比不怪姐姐，是自己母亲造成的，但这种下意识的比较也让她挺不舒服的。

但她和姐姐平时关系一直都挺好的，有啥也是姐姐让着她，就包括网恋对象，最开始她可能就是想单纯跟姐姐抢，可到了后来她渐渐真的有些喜欢上了这个隔了上千公里的男孩。

“哎哟，我怎么死了，我好笨呀，舟舟。”

“没事没事，咱们慢慢练嘛，我刚开始玩游戏的时候还不如你呢，我一局死好几十次！”

“真的嘛，你就骗人吧，你都有大国标，你肯定一开始就很会玩！”

“不骗你，你比我聪明多啦，慢慢学也就会了。”

她现在也知道为什么舟舟去年一年玩游戏基本上都只在晚上9点玩了，当时她听舟舟说成绩不好，还以为他去工作了，没想到是去高中复读了一年，晚上还要陪自己玩游戏玩到那么晚。

她也想过见面，但不知道怎么跟姐姐那边说，也不知道怎么跟舟舟说，难不成直接跟他说你是我跟我姐姐俩人的网恋对象？

这要是让舟舟知道了，按他的性格不得吓死？然后再也不理自己了？

但现在不一样了，现在自己先认识了舟舟，而且姐姐也没见过舟舟长啥样，只要自己让舟舟和姐姐那边断掉，再瞒到等姐姐忘掉舟舟，那舟舟就是自己一个人的了。

至于姐姐那边，在张晚柠看来这样虽然有些不太好，可这样也是对俩人最好的结局了，毕竟如果真的舟舟知道真相的话，那后果简直不堪设想，她也会错过一个为了自己复读一年，跨越千里来到自己城市，满眼都是自己的男生。

姐姐，对不起，是我先遇到舟舟的，也是我先和舟舟见面的。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Zhang Wanning immediately responded to the message because she told her sister that she would not go back today, but she did not tell her mother. Now her sister was asking her question and it was her mother who asked.

[I'm at school. Mom, please help me deal with it. Just say I'm going to participate in an activity.】

Sister: [Hey, okay, I don’t know whether she believes it or not. I’ll try my best to hide it for you.】

After sending the message, Zhang Wanning glanced at Zhouzhou walking in front of her, and suddenly she felt a little guilty towards her sister. After all, Zhouzhou first met her playing games, but it was really her sister who took the initiative in online dating.

At that time, they only had one mobile phone, and the WeChat account they used was also registered by their mother. Naturally, they agreed to play 246 by themselves, 135 with my sister, and each would play for half a day on weekends. At that time, I had a quarrel with my sister about this.

"How can I play games with him when you are dating him online, and I obviously met him first, how can you steal my friend!"

"I'll never pay attention to you again!"

There was really nothing her sister could do, so she walked to her side and comforted her.

"Ning Ning, let's take turns, okay?"

At that time, Zhang Wanning didn't know why she had to compete with her sister. Maybe her sister had been better than him in everything since she was a child, had better grades than him, and got into Nancheng University. As a result, her mother scolded her sister less often, but she always brought her sister with her when she scolded her.

"Can't you just learn from your sister and make me worry-free like her?"

"You're a little girl, so what do you say? Girls need to be like your sister, gentle and kind, so that they can marry a good husband in the future!"

Zhang Wanning was very unhappy. After all, why did she have to be like her sister? Although she knew that this comparison was not her sister's fault but her mother's fault, this subconscious comparison also made her quite uncomfortable.

But she and her sister have always had a good relationship, and her sister let her do everything, including online dating partners. At first, she might just want to compete with her sister, but later on, she gradually really fell in love with this boy who was thousands of kilometers away.

"Oh, why am I dead? I'm so stupid, Zhouzhou."

"It's okay, let's practice slowly. When I first started playing games, I was not as good as you. I died dozens of times in one game!"

"Really, just lie to me. You have a big national standard. You must be very good at playing from the beginning!"

"I'm not going to lie to you, you are much smarter than me, and you will learn slowly."

She now also knows why Zhouzhou basically only played games at 9pm last year. At that time, she heard Zhouzhou said that his grades were not good, and she thought he had gone to work. Unexpectedly, he went to high school to repeat his studies for a year, and he had to play games with her until so late at night.

She also thought about meeting, but she didn't know how to tell her sister, or how to tell Zhouzhou. Is it possible to tell him directly that you are my sister and I's online dating partner?

If Zhouzhou knew this, wouldn't he be frightened to death according to his character?And then never take care of yourself again?

But it's different now. Now I got to know Zhouzhou first, and my sister has never seen what Zhouzhou looks like. As long as I let Zhouzhou and her sister break off, and then hide it until my sister forgets about Zhouzhou, then Zhouzhou will be his alone.

As for her sister, although this is not a good idea in Zhang Wanning's opinion, it is also the best ending for the two of them. After all, if Zhouzhou really knows the truth, the consequences will be unimaginable. She will also miss a boy who has traveled thousands of miles to come to her city just to repeat her studies for a year, and who can only see her.

Sister, I'm sorry, it was me who met Zhouzhou first, and I was also the one who met Zhouzhou first.
